articles.title_en: Bank capital requirement shocks: A narrative perspective
articles.title_cn: 银行资本要求冲击：叙事视角
articles.abstract_en: We provide new estimates of the impact of shocks to bank capital requirements on lending supply and macroeconomic activity based on a Bayesian VAR estimated on Italian data and identified combining sign and narrative restrictions. Narrative restrictions are based on the EBA 2011 Stress Test (ST) and the ECB 2014 Comprehensive Assessment (CA) and are corroborated by evidence from the Euro Area Bank Lending Survey. IRFs show that shocks to required capital persistently reduce R.W.A. and loan supply and lead to a temporary decline in GDP. Based on historical decomposition, the ST and the CA increased banks’ Tier 1 ratio by 40 bps and determined a contraction in loan supply and GDP after two years of up to 1.5% and 0.5%, respectively. Results are robust to using alternative narrative restrictions and hold also when controlling for market pressure during the sovereign debt crisis and for global shocks to bank capitalization.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们根据对意大利数据进行的贝叶斯 VAR 估计，并结合符号和叙述限制，对银行资本要求冲击对贷款供应和宏观经济活动的影响提供了新的估计。叙述限制基于 EBA 2011 压力测试 (ST) 和欧洲央行 2014 综合评估 (CA)，并得到欧元区银行贷款调查证据的证实。 IRF 显示，对所需资本的冲击会持续降低 R.W.A.和贷款供应，导致 GDP 暂时下降。根据历史分解，ST和CA将银行的Tier 1比率提高了40个基点，并确定贷款供应和GDP在两年后分别收缩至1.5%和0.5%。使用替代叙述限制的结果是稳健的，并且在控制主权债务危机期间的市场压力和银行资本化的全球冲击时也成立。

articles.title_en: Communicating Monetary Policy Rules
articles.title_cn: 沟通货币政策规则
articles.abstract_en: Despite the ubiquity of inflation targeting, central banks communicate their frameworks in a variety of ways. No central bank explicitly expresses their conduct via a policy rule, which contrasts with models of policy. Central banks often connect theory with practice by publishing inflation forecasts that can, in principle, implicitly convey their reaction function. We return to this central idea to show how a central bank can achieve the gains of a rule-based policy without publicly stating a specific rule. The approach requires central banks to specify an inflation target, inflation tolerance bands, and provide economic projections. When inflation moves outside the band, inflation forecasts provide a time frame over which inflation will return to within the band. We show how this communication replicates and provides the same information as a rule-based policy. The communication strategy produces a natural benchmark for assessing central bank performance. We illustrate these features in a counterfactual monetary policy history of the United States.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管通胀目标制无处不在，中央银行以各种方式沟通其框架。没有中央银行明确地通过政策规则来表达其行为，这与政策模型形成对比。中央银行通常通过发布通胀预测来连接理论与实践，这些预测原则上可以隐含地传达其反应函数。我们回到这一核心思想，展示中央银行如何在不公开陈述具体规则的情况下实现基于规则的政策的收益。该方法要求中央银行明确通胀目标、通胀容忍区间，并提供经济预测。当通胀偏离区间时，通胀预测提供了通胀回归区间内的时间框架。我们展示了这种沟通如何复制并提供与基于规则的政策相同的信息。该沟通策略为评估中央银行绩效提供了一个自然基准。我们在美国的一个反事实货币政策历史中说明了这些特征。

articles.title_en: Economic forecasting with an agent-based model
articles.title_cn: 基于主体模型的经济预测
articles.abstract_en: We develop the first agent-based model (ABM) that can compete with benchmark VAR and DSGE models in out-of-sample forecasting of macro variables. Our ABM for a small open economy uses micro and macro data from national accounts, sector accounts, input–output tables, government statistics, and census and business demography data. The model incorporates all economic activities as classified by the European System of Accounts (ESA 2010) and includes all economic sectors populated with millions of heterogeneous agents. In addition to being a competitive model framework for forecasts of aggregate variables, the detailed structure of the ABM allows for a breakdown into sector-level forecasts. Using this detailed structure, we demonstrate the ABM by forecasting the medium-run macroeconomic effects of lockdown measures taken in Austria to combat the COVID-19 pandemic. Potential applications of the model include stress-testing and predicting the effects of monetary or fiscal macroeconomic policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了第一个能够在宏观变量的样本外预测中与基准VAR和DSGE模型竞争的主体模型（ABM）。我们的ABM针对一个小型开放经济体，使用来自国民账户、部门账户、投入产出表、政府统计以及人口普查和商业人口统计数据中的微观和宏观数据。该模型包含了欧洲账户体系（ESA 2010）分类的所有经济活动，并包括所有经济部门，其中填充了数百万个异质主体。除了作为聚合变量预测的竞争性模型框架外，ABM的详细结构还允许分解为部门级预测。利用这一详细结构，我们通过预测奥地利为应对COVID-19大流行而采取的封锁措施的中期宏观经济影响来展示ABM。该模型的潜在应用包括压力测试和预测货币或财政宏观经济政策的影响。

articles.title_en: Taxation and the transfer of patents: Evidence from Europe
articles.title_cn: 税收与专利转让：来自欧洲的证据
articles.abstract_en: I study how taxes affect firms’ incentives to shift the location of intangible assets. Using firm-level data on patent reassignments, I exploit variations in statutory tax rates and the introduction of “patent box” policies as shocks modifying incentives to transfer patents across countries. The results suggest a large impact of taxes on asset shifting between affiliates, increasing with expected patent income, and driven by very large firms. Patent boxes are persistently associated with more incoming and less outgoing patent relocations between affiliates. These findings suggest that taxes provide firms with incentives to shift income via patent relocation, and advocate for considering patent transfer strategies in tax policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了税收如何影响企业转移无形资产位置的激励。利用企业层面的专利重新转让数据，我利用法定税率的变化和“专利盒”政策的引入作为冲击，这些冲击改变了跨国转移专利的激励。结果表明，税收对关联企业之间的资产转移有显著影响，这种影响随着预期专利收入的增加而增大，并且由非常大的企业驱动。专利盒政策持续地与关联企业之间更多的专利流入和更少的专利流出相关。这些发现表明，税收为企业通过专利转移来转移收入提供了激励，并主张在税收政策中考虑专利转移策略。

articles.title_en: The value of sick pay
articles.title_cn: 病假工资的价值
articles.abstract_en: Not all countries provide universal access to publicly funded paid sick pay. Amongst countries that do, compensation rates can be low and coverage incomplete. This leaves a significant role for employer-provided paid sick pay in many countries. In this paper, we study who has access to employer-provided sick pay and how much it is valued by workers for themselves and others. We find that workers in jobs with high contact to others are particularly unlikely to have employer provided sick pay, as are economically insecure workers who are least able to afford unpaid time off work. We find that workers without sick pay are more likely to say that they will work when experiencing cold-like symptoms and are less willing to expose themselves to health risks at work during the pandemic. Using vignettes, we reveal that large shares of workers have a very high, but even more have a very low willingness to sacrifice earnings for access to sick pay. Together our findings highlight the unequal distribution of access to sick pay and the potentially strong negative externalities of not providing it publicly. The pandemic may have made these issues more salient as perceived probabilities of having to self-isolate are positively related to support for publicly provided sick pay. Finally, we find that providing information on the health externality of paid sick leave increases support for the public provision of sick pay, suggesting that there might be a public under-provision because individuals do not factor in the externalities.
articles.abstract_cn: 并非所有国家都提供普遍享有的公共资助带薪病假。在提供此类津贴的国家中，补偿率可能较低且覆盖范围不完整。这使得在许多国家，雇主提供的带薪病假扮演着重要角色。在本文中，我们研究了谁能够获得雇主提供的病假工资，以及工人对自己和他人的重视程度。我们发现，与他人接触较多的工作岗位上的工人特别不可能获得雇主提供的病假工资，经济上不安全的工人也是如此，他们最无力承担无薪休假。我们发现，没有病假工资的工人更有可能表示在出现感冒症状时会继续工作，并且在疫情期间更不愿意在工作中暴露于健康风险。通过情景实验，我们揭示出很大比例的工人对牺牲收入换取病假工资的意愿非常高，但更多的人意愿非常低。我们的发现共同凸显了病假工资获取的不平等分配，以及不公开提供病假工资可能带来的强烈负面外部性。疫情可能使这些问题更加突出，因为感知到的自我隔离概率与对公共提供病假工资的支持呈正相关。最后，我们发现提供关于带薪病假健康外部性的信息会增加对公共提供病假工资的支持，这表明可能存在公共供给不足，因为个人没有将外部性考虑在内。

articles.title_en: The state of hiring discrimination: A meta-analysis of (almost) all recent correspondence experiments
articles.title_cn: 招聘歧视的现状：对（几乎）所有近期通信实验的元分析
articles.abstract_en: Notwithstanding the improved integration of various minority groups in the workforce, unequal treatment in hiring still hinders many individuals’ access to the labour market. To tackle this inaccessibility, it is essential to know which and to what extent minority groups face hiring discrimination. This meta-analysis synthesises a quasi-exhaustive register of correspondence experiments on hiring discrimination published between 2005 and 2020. Using a random-effects model, we computed pooled discrimination ratios concerning ten discrimination grounds upon which unequal treatment in hiring is forbidden by law. Our meta-analysis shows that hiring discrimination against candidates with disabilities, older candidates, and less physically attractive candidates seems equally severe as the unequal treatment of candidates with salient racial or ethnic characteristics. Moreover, hiring discrimination against older applicants is more prominent in Europe than in the United States. Last, while we initially find a significant decrease in ethnic hiring discrimination in (Western) Europe, we find no structural evidence of recent temporal changes in hiring discrimination when controlling for the minority groups considered, at the country level, or based on the various other grounds within the scope of this review.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管各少数群体在劳动力市场中的融入有所改善，但招聘中的不平等对待仍阻碍许多个人进入劳动力市场。为解决这一不可及性问题，了解哪些少数群体面临招聘歧视及其程度至关重要。本元分析综合了2005年至2020年间发表的关于招聘歧视的通信实验的准详尽登记。使用随机效应模型，我们计算了关于法律禁止招聘中不平等对待的十种歧视理由的合并歧视比率。我们的元分析表明，针对残疾候选人、年长候选人和外貌吸引力较低的候选人的招聘歧视，似乎与对具有显著种族或民族特征的候选人的不平等对待同样严重。此外，对年长申请人的招聘歧视在欧洲比在美国更为突出。最后，虽然我们最初发现（西欧）种族招聘歧视显著下降，但在控制所考虑的少数群体、国家层面或本综述范围内的其他各种理由时，我们未发现近期招聘歧视时间变化的结构性证据。

articles.title_en: The demographic transition and the asset supply channel
articles.title_cn: 人口转变与资产供给渠道
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the macroeconomic consequences of a demographic transition in an environment where a producer’s capital structure is relevant, thereby introducing an asset supply channel. Producers are heterogeneous with respect to how productive they are in different states of the world, and may pursue different combinations of safe and/or risky securities issuance when financing projects. I simulate a demographic transition calibrated to replicate the US experience starting in 1880. This transition results in modest increases in output, larger increases in saving as a whole and, particularly, in a relative increase in saving in the form of safe assets. Lower capital costs lead to producer entry (and more issuance) and to a tilt towards safe issuance. I show that omitting this asset supply channel, as standard representative firm models do, results in a quantitatively important overestimation of the transmission effects of the demographic transition, with larger output gains despite smaller interest rate reductions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在生产者资本结构具有相关性的环境中，人口转变的宏观经济后果，从而引入了资产供给渠道。生产者在不同世界状态下的生产率存在异质性，并且在为项目融资时可能采用安全证券和/或风险证券的不同组合。我模拟了一个以复制美国自1880年开始的经验为校准目标的人口转变。这一转变导致产出适度增加，储蓄整体更大幅度增加，尤其是以安全资产形式储蓄的相对增加。较低的资本成本导致生产者进入（并增加发行），并倾向于安全发行。我表明，忽略这一资产供给渠道（如标准代表性企业模型所做的那样）会导致对人口转变传导效应的定量重要高估，尽管利率下降幅度较小，但产出增长更大。

articles.title_en: Understanding cognitive decline in older ages: The role of health shocks
articles.title_cn: 理解老年认知衰退：健康冲击的作用
articles.abstract_en: Individual cognitive functioning declines over time. We seek to understand how adverse physical health shocks in older ages contribute to this development. By use of event-study methods and data from the USA, England, and several countries in Continental Europe, we find evidence that health shocks lead to an immediate and persistent decline in cognitive functioning. This robust finding holds in all regions representing different health insurance systems and seems to be independent of underlying individual demographic characteristics such as sex and age. We also ask whether variables that are susceptible to policy action can reduce the negative consequences of a health shock. Our results suggest that neither compulsory education nor retirement regulations moderate the effects, thus emphasizing the importance for cognitive functioning of maintaining good physical health in old age.
articles.abstract_cn: 个体认知功能随时间下降。我们试图理解老年期不良身体健康冲击如何促成这一发展。通过使用事件研究方法和来自美国、英格兰以及欧洲大陆多个国家的数据，我们发现证据表明健康冲击导致认知功能立即且持续下降。这一稳健发现在代表不同医疗保险体系的所有地区均成立，并且似乎独立于性别和年龄等潜在个体人口特征。我们还询问那些易受政策影响的变量是否能减少健康冲击的负面后果。我们的结果表明，义务教育或退休规定均不能调节这些影响，从而强调了在老年期保持良好身体健康对认知功能的重要性。

articles.title_en: Asylum policies and international tensions
articles.title_cn: 庇护政策与国际紧张关系
articles.abstract_en: This article examines how international relation dynamics shape asylum policies. Using data on asylum applications in the European Union (EU) and international events from 1999 to 2017, we document that EU Member States admit relatively more refugees when diplomatic relations with the country of origin deteriorate. This result holds after controlling for push and pull factors as well as bilateral determinants of refugee migration. Our results highlight the importance of non-humanitarian factors in the grant of political asylum.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了国际关系动态如何影响庇护政策。利用1999年至2017年欧盟（EU）的庇护申请数据和国际事件数据，我们记录了当与来源国的外交关系恶化时，欧盟成员国接纳的难民相对更多。在控制了推动和拉动因素以及难民迁移的双边决定因素后，这一结果依然成立。我们的结果强调了非人道主义因素在授予政治庇护中的重要性。

articles.title_en: Does working from home work? A natural experiment from lockdowns
articles.title_cn: 居家办公有效吗？来自封锁政策的自然实验
articles.abstract_en: Using tracked changes from a large open-source software platform, this paper studies how working from home affected the output of individuals working in tech. The basis of the natural experiment comes from idiosyncratic and state-imposed workplace closures during the COVID-19 pandemic. I find a negative but almost-negligible change in individual-level output of 0.5 percent (standard error of 0.091 percent). Overall, and based on descriptive analyses of the time-stamped data, tracked changes in software development cadences approximate regular work activity and provide a useful avenue for future studies of work.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用大型开源软件平台上的追踪变更，本文研究了居家办公如何影响科技行业从业者的产出。该自然实验的基础源于COVID-19疫情期间各州实施的、具有特异性的工作场所关闭政策。我发现个体层面的产出出现了负向但几乎可忽略的变化，为0.5%（标准误为0.091%）。总体而言，基于对带时间戳数据的描述性分析，软件开发节奏中的追踪变更近似于常规工作活动，并为未来的工作研究提供了有用的途径。

articles.title_en: Fiscal stimulus in liquidity traps: Conventional or unconventional policies?
articles.title_cn: 流动性陷阱中的财政刺激：常规还是非常规政策？
articles.abstract_en: Recent influential work argue that a gradual increase in the sales tax stimulates economic activity in a liquidity trap by boosting inflation expectations. Higher public infrastructure investment should also be more expansive in a liquidity trap than in normal times by raising the potential interest rate and increasing aggregate demand. We analyze the relative merits of these policies in New Keynesian models with and without endogenous private capital formation and heterogeneity when monetary policy does not respond by raising policy rates. Our key finding is that the effectiveness of sales tax hikes differs notably across various model specifications, whereas the benefits of higher public infrastructure investment are more robust in alternative model environments. We therefore conclude that fiscal policymakers in liquidity traps should consider spending opportunities and not merely rely on tax policies to stimulate growth.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期有影响力的研究认为，在流动性陷阱中，逐步提高销售税通过提升通胀预期来刺激经济活动。更高的公共基础设施投资也应通过提高潜在利率和增加总需求，在流动性陷阱中比正常时期更具扩张性。我们在有和没有内生私人资本形成及异质性的新凯恩斯模型中，分析这些政策的相对优劣，此时货币政策不通过提高政策利率来回应。我们的关键发现是，销售税上调的有效性在不同模型设定下差异显著，而更高公共基础设施投资的益处在替代模型环境中更为稳健。因此，我们得出结论，流动性陷阱中的财政政策制定者应考虑支出机会，而不仅仅依赖税收政策来刺激增长。

articles.title_en: Consumer mobility and expenditure during the COVID-19 containments: Evidence from French transaction data
articles.title_cn: COVID-19封锁期间的消费者流动与支出：来自法国交易数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effects of the pandemic containment periods in France on individuals’ movements, expenditure and adaptation to the shock, using billions of French bank card transactions measured before and during the COVID-19 pandemic. We measure not only the effect on consumer expenditure, but also on quantities directly related to the containment restrictions, such as consumer mobility, number of retailers visited, and inter-regional purchases. The results show large effects on these measures of consumers’ movements, as well as on both online and offline measures of expenditure, particularly in the first containment period. We also find evidence that consumers adjusted rapidly during the first containment period, mitigating the effects of mobility restrictions via an increasing shift toward online purchasing, and that the nature of the adaptation differed for different types of purchase.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用法国数十亿笔银行卡交易数据（涵盖COVID-19疫情前后），研究了法国疫情封锁期对个人流动、支出及对冲击适应性的影响。我们不仅衡量了对消费者支出的影响，还衡量了与封锁限制直接相关的数量指标，如消费者流动性、访问的零售商数量以及跨区域购买。结果显示，这些消费者流动指标以及线上和线下支出指标均受到显著影响，尤其是在第一次封锁期间。我们还发现，在第一次封锁期间，消费者迅速调整，通过转向线上购买来缓解流动性限制的影响，并且不同购买类型的适应性质有所不同。

articles.title_en: Monetary–fiscal crosswinds in the European Monetary Union
articles.title_cn: 欧洲货币联盟中的货币-财政交叉风
articles.abstract_en: We study the monetary–fiscal mix in the European Monetary Union. The medium and long-run effects of conventional and unconventional monetary policy are analysed by combining monetary policy shocks identified in a Structural VAR, and the general government budget constraint featuring a single central bank and multiple fiscal authorities. In response to a conventional easing of the policy rate, the cumulated response of the fiscal deficit is positive. Conversely, in response to an unconventional easing affecting the long end of the yield curve, the primary fiscal position barely moves. This is consistent with the long-run effect of unconventional monetary easing on the price index, which is about half that of conventional easing. The aggregate long-run cumulated surplus is mainly driven by Germany’s fiscal policy during the period in which unconventional monetary policy was adopted.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究欧洲货币联盟中的货币-财政组合。通过结合结构向量自回归中识别的货币政策冲击，以及具有单一中央银行和多个财政当局的广义政府预算约束，分析常规和非常规货币政策的中期和长期效应。对于政策利率的常规宽松，财政赤字的累积响应为正。相反，对于影响收益率曲线长端的非常规宽松，基本财政状况几乎不变。这与非常规货币宽松对价格指数的长期效应一致，该效应约为常规宽松的一半。在采用非常规货币政策的时期，总体长期累积盈余主要由德国的财政政策驱动。

articles.title_en: Structural change and productivity growth in Europe — Past, present and future
articles.title_cn: 欧洲的结构变化与生产率增长——过去、现在与未来
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of structural change on the historical path of aggregate labor productivity growth for a large sample of European countries, and it builds a quantitative multi-sector growth model to analyze the potential impact that structural change may have on future productivity growth. We document that the observed reallocation of economic activity since the 1970s towards the service sector has exerted a strongly negative effect on aggregate productivity growth in most European countries. Moreover, we perform a quantitative analysis to show that the expected path of structural change might continue to have a sizeable dent on future productivity growth in Europe. By contrast, the impact in the U.S. is expected to rapidly diminish. We show that this differential result can be explained by the large expansion, in Europe, of certain service sub-sectors characterized by stagnant productivity.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了结构变化对欧洲国家大样本历史总劳动生产率增长路径的影响，并构建了一个定量多部门增长模型来分析结构变化可能对未来生产率增长产生的潜在影响。我们记录了自1970年以来观察到的经济活动向服务业部门的重新配置对大多数欧洲国家总生产率增长产生了强烈的负面影响。此外，我们进行了定量分析，表明预期的结构变化路径可能继续对欧洲未来的生产率增长产生显著影响。相比之下，美国的影响预计将迅速减弱。我们表明，这种差异结果可以解释为欧洲某些以生产率停滞为特征的特定服务子部门的大幅扩张。

articles.title_en: The macroeconomics of age-varying epidemics
articles.title_cn: 年龄变化流行病的宏观经济学
articles.abstract_en: We incorporate age-specific socio-economic interactions in a SIR macroeconomic model to study the role of demographic factors for the COVID-19 epidemic evolution, its macroeconomic effects and possible containment measures. We capture the endogenous response of rational individuals who choose to reduce inter- and intra-generational social interactions, consumption- and labor-related personal exposure to the virus, while not internalizing the impact of their actions on others. We find that social distancing measures targeted to the elderly (who face higher mortality risk and are not part of the labor force) are best suited to save lives and mitigate output losses. The optimal economic shutdown generates small gains in terms of lives saved and large output losses, for any given type of social distancing. These results are confirmed by calibrating the model to match real epidemic and economic data in the context of a scenario exercise.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在SIR宏观经济模型中纳入年龄特定的社会经济互动，以研究人口因素对COVID-19疫情演变、其宏观经济影响及可能的遏制措施的作用。我们捕捉理性个体的内生反应，他们选择减少代际间和代际内的社会互动、消费和劳动相关的个人病毒暴露，同时不内化其行为对他人的影响。我们发现，针对老年人（他们面临更高的死亡风险且不属于劳动力）的社交距离措施最适合拯救生命并减轻产出损失。最优的经济停摆在任何给定的社交距离类型下，在拯救生命方面产生微小收益，而在产出损失方面产生巨大损失。这些结果通过校准模型以匹配情景演练中的真实疫情和经济数据得到证实。

articles.title_en: Preventing financial disasters: Macroprudential policy and financial crises
articles.title_cn: 防范金融灾难：宏观审慎政策与金融危机
articles.abstract_en: The ultimate goal of macroprudential policy is to prevent and reduce the costs of systemic financial crises, and thus contribute to promoting sustainable economic growth. However, despite the active role played by such policies in recent decades, there is still limited empirical evidence regarding whether prudential regulation is effective to enhance financial stability by preventing and mitigating crisis risk. This paper seeks to close that gap by studying the relationship between macroprudential policy and both the likelihood and severity of financial crises. The contribution of the paper is twofold. First, I show that macroprudential policy tightenings are successful at reducing the frequency of systemic financial crises. Moreover, this result holds even if macroprudential policies are implemented when the economy is already experiencing a financial boom or when monetary conditions are rather accommodative. I point to the prevention and mitigation of financial booms as the main transmission mechanism through which macroprudential policy defuses crisis risk. Second, I find that macroprudential policy enhances the resilience of the financial system, by dampening the output losses associated with future systemic financial crises. The latter result implies that macroprudential policy not only makes financial crises less likely, but also less painful.
articles.abstract_cn: 宏观审慎政策的最终目标是预防和降低系统性金融危机的成本，从而促进可持续的经济增长。然而，尽管此类政策在近几十年中发挥了积极作用，关于审慎监管是否能有效通过预防和缓解危机风险来增强金融稳定性的经验证据仍然有限。本文旨在通过研究宏观审慎政策与金融危机的可能性和严重性之间的关系来填补这一空白。本文的贡献有两方面。首先，我表明宏观审慎政策的收紧能够成功降低系统性金融危机的发生频率。此外，即使在经济已经经历金融繁荣或货币条件相当宽松时实施宏观审慎政策，这一结果仍然成立。我将预防和缓解金融繁荣视为宏观审慎政策化解危机风险的主要传导机制。其次，我发现宏观审慎政策通过抑制与未来系统性金融危机相关的产出损失，增强了金融体系的韧性。后一结果意味着宏观审慎政策不仅使金融危机更不可能发生，而且使其痛苦程度更低。

articles.title_en: Immigrant intergenerational mobility: A focus on childhood environment
articles.title_cn: 移民的代际流动性：关注童年环境
articles.abstract_en: Over 60% of immigrant parents in Sweden start off in the bottom quintile of the income distribution, yet only about 30% of their children are still in the bottom income quintile in adulthood. This progress notwithstanding, we show using administrative data that immigrant children who grow up in the 20th income percentile place three income ranks lower than native children of similarly low-income parents. This income gap cannot be explained by differences in parent education levels, family structure, or municipality of residence. The gap can, however, be explained by differences in immediate, 100 × 100 - m neighborhoods. Immigrant children grow up in relatively denser neighborhoods with fewer native-born and high-earning neighbors. Data from Stockholm suggest that immigrant families sort into different neighborhoods than natives due to Sweden’s rental housing allocation mechanism that is based on waiting time rather than market rents.
articles.abstract_cn: 瑞典超过60%的移民父母起初处于收入分配的最底层的五分之一，但他们的子女中只有约30%在成年后仍处于收入最底层的五分之一。尽管有这种进步，我们使用行政数据表明，在收入百分位第20位成长的移民子女，其收入排名比收入同样低的本地父母所生的子女低三个收入等级。这一收入差距无法用父母教育水平、家庭结构或居住城市的差异来解释。然而，这一差距可以用直接的、100×100米的邻里差异来解释。移民子女成长的邻里相对更密集，且本地出生和高收入的邻居较少。来自斯德哥尔摩的数据表明，由于瑞典的租赁住房分配机制基于等待时间而非市场租金，移民家庭与本地家庭会选择不同的邻里居住。

articles.title_en: Germany’s capacity to work from home
articles.title_cn: 德国居家办公能力
articles.abstract_en: We propose an index of working from home (WFH) capacity for the German economy, drawing on rich survey and administrative data. We find that 56 percent of jobs are WFH feasible, most of which are located in urban areas and in highly digitized industries. Using individual-level data on tasks and work conditions, we show that heterogeneity in WFH feasibility is largely explained by differences in task content. WFH feasible jobs are typically characterized by cognitive, non-manual tasks, and PC usage. We compare our survey-based measure with popular task-based measures of WFH capacity, which usually rely on determining tasks that are incompatible with WFH, and show that task-based approaches capture variation in WFH capacity across occupations fairly accurately. A simple measure of PC use intensity will generally constitute a suitable proxy for WFH capacity. Finally, we demonstrate that our WFH index is a strong predictor of actual WFH outcomes during the Covid-19 crisis and discuss applications in the context of the pandemic and the future of work.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用丰富的调查和行政数据，为德国经济提出一个居家办公（WFH）能力指数。我们发现56%的工作岗位适合居家办公，其中大部分位于城市地区和高数字化行业。利用关于任务和工作条件的个体层面数据，我们表明居家办公可行性的异质性在很大程度上由任务内容的差异所解释。适合居家办公的工作通常具有认知性、非体力任务和电脑使用的特点。我们将基于调查的度量与流行的基于任务的居家办公能力度量进行比较，后者通常依赖于确定与居家办公不相容的任务，并表明基于任务的方法能够相当准确地捕捉各职业居家办公能力的差异。一个简单的电脑使用强度度量通常可以作为居家办公能力的合适代理指标。最后，我们证明我们的居家办公指数是新冠19危机期间实际居家办公结果的强预测因子，并讨论了在疫情和未来工作背景下的应用。

articles.title_en: Saving constraints, inequality, and the credit market response to fiscal stimulus
articles.title_cn: 储蓄约束、不平等与财政刺激的信贷市场反应
articles.abstract_en: We document substantial heterogeneity in the interest rate response to fiscal stimulus (IRRF) across OECD economies. The IRRF is negative in half of the OECD countries, and it declines with income inequality. To interpret this evidence we develop a model in which moderately-low-income households take on debt to maintain a consumption threshold (effectively a saving constraint). Now burdened with debt, these households use additional income to deleverage. In more unequal economies with more saving-constrained households, increases in government spending tighten credit conditions less (relax credit conditions more), leading to smaller increases (larger declines) in the interest rate.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了OECD经济体中财政刺激利率反应（IRRF）的显著异质性。IRRF在半数OECD国家为负，且随收入不平等程度下降而降低。为解释这一证据，我们构建了一个模型，其中中等偏低收入家庭为维持消费阈值（实际上是储蓄约束）而举债。这些家庭现在背负债务，利用额外收入去杠杆。在储蓄约束家庭更多的不平等经济体中，政府支出增加对信贷条件的收紧程度较小（放松程度较大），导致利率上升幅度较小（下降幅度较大）。

articles.title_en: Gender-based price discrimination in the annuity market: Evidence from Chile
articles.title_cn: 年金市场中的性别价格歧视：来自智利的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides the first evidence for discriminatory behaviour against female consumers in the annuity market. It focuses on Chile, where an electronic bidding system allows retirees to receive offers, simultaneously from several firms in the market for the same standardised annuity product. By exploiting within-individual variation in initial offers across firms, this analysis shows that firms with market power offer more unfairly priced annuities to women than to men. This result is driven by highly rated firms. Gender differences in financial literacy can explain why firms find it profitable to offer higher prices to women.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了年金市场中针对女性消费者歧视行为的首个证据。研究聚焦于智利，该国采用电子竞价系统，使退休人员能够同时从市场中的多家公司收到针对同一标准化年金产品的报价。通过利用个体内部不同公司初始报价的差异，本分析表明，拥有市场势力的公司向女性提供的年金定价比男性更不公平。这一结果由高评级公司驱动。金融素养的性别差异可以解释为何公司发现向女性提供更高价格是有利可图的。

articles.title_en: Gains from monetary policy cooperation under asymmetric currency pricing
articles.title_cn: 非对称货币定价下货币政策合作的收益
articles.abstract_en: In most international trade transactions, the U.S. dollar is used. Hence, this study considers optimal monetary policy in a two-country model under asymmetric currency pricing (ACP) in which U.S. (Home) firms use producer currency pricing (PCP) while firms in the rest of the world (Foreign) use local currency pricing (LCP). In the ACP model, there is an additional inefficiency, namely, the internal relative price distortion compared with the LCP model and the distortion arising from deviations from the law of one price compared with the PCP model. Consequently, welfare gains from monetary policy cooperation in the ACP model are substantially greater compared with the LCP and PCP models. Moreover, the noncooperative Foreign policymakers in the ACP model can manipulate not only the internal relative price but also deviations from the law of one price in favor of their own welfare through nominal exchange rate adjustment, whereas the noncooperative Home policymakers can control neither. This result rationalizes the fact that the U.S. designates currency manipulators to protect its welfare. Therefore, gains from cooperation in Home are larger than in Foreign. Furthermore, I find that there are substantial gains from cooperation in the ACP model even under the conditions that remove gains from cooperation in the LCP and PCP models.
articles.abstract_cn: 在国际贸易交易中，美元被广泛使用。因此，本研究考虑在非对称货币定价（ACP）的两国模型中的最优货币政策，其中美国（本国）企业采用生产者货币定价（PCP），而世界其他地区（外国）企业采用当地货币定价（LCP）。在ACP模型中，存在额外的低效率，即与LCP模型相比的内部相对价格扭曲，以及与PCP模型相比的一价定律偏离所产生的扭曲。因此，与LCP和PCP模型相比，ACP模型中货币政策合作的福利收益要大得多。此外，在ACP模型中，非合作的外国政策制定者不仅可以通过名义汇率调整操纵内部相对价格，还可以操纵一价定律的偏离以利于自身福利，而本国的非合作政策制定者则无法控制这两者。这一结果解释了美国指定汇率操纵国以保护其福利的事实。因此，本国合作的收益大于外国。此外，我发现即使在消除LCP和PCP模型中合作收益的条件下，ACP模型中仍存在可观的合作收益。

articles.title_en: Levelling the debt–equity playing field: Evidence from Belgium
articles.title_cn: 平衡债务与股权的竞争环境：来自比利时的证据
articles.abstract_en: I explore whether a Belgian policy that reduced the corporate tax bias towards debt finance was successful in lowering firm leverage. Using putatively exogenous time series variation in the cost of equity financing and a difference-in-differences strategy that includes similar firms from surrounding countries, I find that the policy did lead to increased equity ratios, with some evidence of a shift from short-term debt to long-term debt.
articles.abstract_cn: 我探讨了比利时一项减少企业税收偏向债务融资的政策是否成功降低了企业杠杆。利用股权融资成本中假定外生的时间序列变化，以及一个包含周边国家类似企业的双重差分策略，我发现该政策确实导致了股权比率的提高，并有一些证据表明从短期债务转向长期债务。

articles.title_en: Indebted sellers, liquidity and mortgage standards
articles.title_cn: 负债卖家、流动性与抵押贷款标准
articles.abstract_en: The effects of households’ indebtedness on their house selling decisions, the implications of these decisions for default and the effects of policies intended to reduce the incentive to default are studied in a dynamic model with search in the housing market and defaultable long-term mortgages. In equilibrium, both sellers’ asking prices and time-to-sell increase with the relative size of their outstanding debt. For sellers in financial distress, this behavior results in a positive relationship between debt and their individual risk of default. Prices and time-to-sell determine both the liquidity of the housing market and the aggregate risk of default. As such they determine the extent of profitable lending by competitive lenders. Calibrated to the U.S. economy, the model also generates, as observed, positive correlations (i) across sellers of asking prices with loan-to-value ratios, and (ii) over time of both house prices and time-to-sell with mortgage loan-to-value ratios at mortgage origination. Policies aimed at reducing default may be counterproductive if they raise the value of mortgages and thus lower lending standards, ultimately increasing the rate of default and reducing aggregate welfare. We consider also the implications of these policies for the effects of aggregate shocks on house prices and the rate and severity of mortgage default.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在一个具有住房市场搜索和可违约长期抵押贷款的动态模型中，研究了家庭负债对其房屋出售决策的影响、这些决策对违约的启示，以及旨在减少违约激励的政策效果。在均衡状态下，卖家的要价和售出时间均随其未偿债务的相对规模增加而增加。对于陷入财务困境的卖家，这种行为导致债务与其个人违约风险之间存在正相关关系。价格和售出时间决定了住房市场的流动性和总体违约风险，因此也决定了竞争性贷款机构可盈利贷款的程度。以美国经济为校准对象，该模型还如观察所示，产生了以下正相关关系：（i）不同卖家的要价与贷款价值比之间，（ii）房价和售出时间随时间与抵押贷款发放时的贷款价值比之间。旨在减少违约的政策如果提高了抵押贷款的价值从而降低了贷款标准，最终可能增加违约率并降低总体福利，从而适得其反。我们还考虑了这些政策对总冲击影响房价以及抵押贷款违约率和严重程度的影响。

articles.title_en: Firm behaviour under negative deposit rates
articles.title_cn: 负存款利率下的企业行为
articles.abstract_en: Using rich microdata from Denmark, the first country in the world to move its key monetary-policy rate below zero, we find that firms which become exposed to negative interest rates on their bank deposits increase their fixed investments and employment to a larger extent than what can be explained by the associated reduction in the level of interest rates. They also tend to rebalance their liquid portfolio, reduce their degree of leverage and become more inclined to change bank connections. Our results also indicate that it is the event of becoming exposed to negative rates (the extensive margin), not the share of deposits exposed to negative interest rates (the intensive margin), that matters for firm behaviour. These findings support the existence of a corporate channel of monetary transmission when bank deposit rates cross zero and become negative.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用丹麦（世界上第一个将关键货币政策利率降至负值的国家）的丰富微观数据，我们发现，那些银行定期存款面临负利率的企业，其固定投资和就业的增加幅度超过了利率水平下降所能解释的范围。它们还倾向于重新平衡其流动性资产组合，降低杠杆率，并更倾向于更换银行关系。我们的结果还表明，是企业面临负利率的事件（广延边际），而非面临负利率的存款比例（集约边际），对企业行为产生影响。这些发现支持了当银行存款利率降至零以下时，存在企业渠道的货币传导机制。

articles.title_en: Taxation, social welfare, and labor market frictions
articles.title_cn: 税收、社会福利与劳动力市场摩擦
articles.abstract_en: Taking taxation inefficiencies as given, a well-known public finance result is that in partial equilibrium the elasticity of taxable income (ETI) is a sufficient statistic for the deadweight loss (DWL) from labor income taxation. We revisit this result using a general equilibrium macroeconomic framework with labor search frictions. Our theory parses out the extent to which search frictions in and of themselves can distort the DWL-ETI relationship. Numerical analysis suggests that DWL is nearly 10 percent above the ETI given search frictions, only. Accounting for externalities can drive this figure up to about 20 percent, and accounting unemployment benefits can increase this number up to nearly 40 percent. Parsing out these effects both analytically and quantitatively yields novel results that contribute jointly to the public finance and macroeconomic literatures.
articles.abstract_cn: 在税收无效率既定的情况下，一个著名的公共财政结果是，在局部均衡中，应税收入弹性（ETI）是劳动所得税无谓损失（DWL）的充分统计量。我们使用具有劳动力搜索摩擦的一般均衡宏观经济框架重新审视这一结果。我们的理论解析了搜索摩擦本身在多大程度上可以扭曲DWL-ETI关系。数值分析表明，仅考虑搜索摩擦时，DWL比ETI高出近10%。考虑外部性可将这一数字推高至约20%，而考虑失业救济金可将这一数字增加至近40%。从分析和数量上解析这些效应，产生了新颖的结果，共同为公共财政和宏观经济文献做出了贡献。
